tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Resolve a free-text Dubai location name (community, area, or building) to canonical slugs. Always call this first when the user names a place; other tools take the returned slugs.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: City-wide Dubai sales KPIs over the last 12 months (transaction count, total value, median price, median price per sqm) plus data freshness. Good first call for broad questions.

tools.name: get_location_stats
tools.description: Headline stats for one community or area slug: 12-month sales volume, median price, price per sqm, 12-month trend, plus a property-class mix for sales and rents. tools.name: get_ready_vs_offplan
tools.description: Sales split between the secondary (ready / resale) market and the off-plan (pre-completion developer) market for one community or area over the last 12 months - transaction count, total value, and median price for each. "ready" = completed homes resold on the secondary market; "off-plan" = pre-compl

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Monthly transaction counts and median prices for a community/area slug (or city-wide when slug is omitted), for sales or rents, optionally filtered to one property class. Rent medians are annual contract values in AED/year.

tools.name: get_building_stats
tools.description: Stats for one building: 12-month sales, median price, trend, recent sales, property-type mix, and - where rent contracts can be attributed to the building - median annual rent and recent rent contracts, and a per-bedroom rent breakdown where enough contracts resolve a bedroom. tools.name: rank_buildings
tools.description: Buildings in one community ranked by 12-month median sale price or median annual rent - answers 'cheapest/most expensive buildings in X'. tools.name: list_recent_transactions
tools.description: Most recent registered DLD sales or rent contracts for a community or area slug - real records to ground price talk in.

tools.name: compare_buy_vs_rent
tools.description: Compare buying vs renting in one community or area: 12-month weighted median sale price, median annual rent, and the implied gross rental yield. Optionally filter to one property class.

tools.name: rank_communities
tools.description: Communities ranked by 12-month median sale price or median annual rent - the direct answer to 'cheapest areas', 'most expensive communities', 'most affordable rents'. tools.name: get_trends_movers
tools.description: Communities with the biggest 12-month price moves (direction 'up' = risers, 'down' = fallers). Only communities with 30+ sales are included, so thin-volume noise is excluded.
